column1: # Commit map for the 2026-11-11 history rewrite.
# Dollar figures (eval run cost estimates and a monthly bill total) were
# removed from every commit that carried them: the changelog, three docs
# notes, and review packages and probe streams on the hyperpowers/state
# branch. 1336 commit ids changed; trees differ only in those files.
# On main and the release tags, commits that are not descendants of 1c6a982
# keep their ids and signatures; on hyperpowers/state every commit after the
# root changed. f4bbd56, which removed the figures from the current tree, is
# empty after the rewrite and was dropped; its new id is all zeros.
